summary: AF2-N stage1 expansion plan: extend the canary allowlist from 3 internal users to roughly 1% of production users. This document is PREP ONLY. Stage1 is NOT applied. Requires separate explicit user approval before any allowlist change.

selection_criteria: opt-in beta testers (if backend has a beta flag, otherwise skip)
NO real player user_ids without explicit consent

abort_triggers_stage1: inventory mismatch > 0 (placeholder; inventory wiring not live yet)
stage1_apply_procedure_DO_NOT_EXECUTE: 2. Update AFFINITY_GIFT_CANARY_ALLOWLIST in backend.conf with the new 50-100 user_id list (comma-separated)
3. Update AFFINITY_GIFT_CANARY_LEDGER_CAP to 500 (or value approved by user)
4. sudo supervisorctl reread && sudo supervisorctl update && sudo supervisorctl restart backend
8. If any abort trigger fires, immediately run /app/ops/rollback_af2n_canary.sh (will reset to pre-canary OR keep canary 3-user state if a stage1-specific rollback script is added separately)
stage1_rollback_procedure: option_A: stage1-specific rollback (recommended) — restore allowlist to the 3 V12 users via supervisor.conf swap
option_B: full rollback to pre-AF2-N — run /app/ops/rollback_af2n_canary.sh
both options preserve canary ledger rows as audit evidence; manual cleanup is a separate optional step
safety_constraints: stage1 must NOT enable inventory mutation, affinity_points mutation, buffs activation, or battle wiring
battle_engine.py / battle_core.py / combat.tsx MUST remain unchanged
gacha / roster / catalog MUST remain unchanged
runbook dry-run REQUIRED before live apply
